newsitem.title: USA: Maxco Inc Q3 Dec 31 oper profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Maxco Inc Q3 Dec 31 oper profit vs loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q3 1996 is before loss of $693,000, or $0.18 a share from discontinued business. Q3 1995 is before income of $54,000, or $0.01, from discontinued businesses.

Also, 1995 figures have been restated to reflect Maxco's change to the equity method of accounting after its increased investment in Medar Inc in 1996. The effect of the restatement was a reduction in net income of $1.2 million, or $0.27 cents a share, in the third quarter of 1995.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Nine months 1996 exclude loss of $594,000, or $0.14 a share, from discontinued businesses, compared with income of $405,000, or $0.09 a share in the year-ago period.
